title: Murder at the villa
intro: Saturday night at the mountain villa. Ivan has gathered his oldest friends for the weekend, and the storm has cut the road behind them.

characters.name: Ivan
characters.backstory: You are Ivan, the host, and tonight you will be found dead in the study. You play the victim: the game master reads out your clues.
clues: A key lies under the flowerpot on the terrace.

characters.name: Ana
characters.backstory: You are Ana, Ivan's business partner. You have been skimming money from the company for two years, and Ivan found out this week. Your goal: make sure nobody opens the cellar.

characters.name: Bob
characters.backstory: You are Bob, Ivan's brother. You owe Ivan a lot of money and you argued about it at dinner. You know Ana left the table at 22:10.

rounds.title: The lights go out
rounds.message: At 22:15 every light in the villa goes out. When they come back, the study door is open and Ivan is on the floor.

characters.Ana: You slipped out in the dark. Make sure nobody finds out where you were.
characters.Bob: In the dark someone brushed past you smelling of petrol. You could not see who.

rounds.message: The storm knocks out the phones. Nobody can leave, and somebody finds a key under the flowerpot.

characters.Bob: You saw Ana come back from the direction of the cellar. Decide whether to tell.

reveal: Ana killed Ivan to hide the missing money, then tried to burn the ledgers in the cellar. The petrol smell and the key under the flowerpot lead to her.
